scope: operations-only adversarial review; no deployment, DNS, credential, schedule, automation, or production mutation

checkpoints.claim_or_design_tested: The preview branch is available as the required non-production integration surface and Cloudflare can be evaluated without conflicting with the canonical Vercel path.
challenge_method: Attempted a safe idempotent preview-branch creation from main
Searched repository content for Cloudflare and Wrangler configuration
Compared observed repository state with the preview/production policy
evidence: Branch discovery returned no preview result
Branch creation returned Reference already exists (HTTP 422), proving preview exists despite discovery failure
PREVIEW_PRODUCTION_POLICY.md assigns preview to adversarial integration and Vercel Preview to canonical verification
Repository code search returned no Cloudflare or Wrangler configuration
failures_or_counterexamples_found: Connector branch search can produce a false negative for an existing branch
A discovery-only workflow could incorrectly create duplicate recovery work or report preview missing
No repository-grounded evidence currently supports an active Cloudflare deployment path
repairs_made: Established an existence check rule: treat an idempotent create-reference 422 as positive branch-existence evidence, not failure
Kept Cloudflare classified as an unverified alternative rather than a live provider
Made no provider, DNS, deployment, or production changes
remaining_uncertainty: Exact preview HEAD commit was not exposed by the branch-search response

checkpoints.claim_or_design_tested: An operations-only evidence record can strengthen governance without altering runtime behavior.
challenge_method: Restricted implementation to a new evidence artifact on preview
Checked for accidental production, DNS, credential, automation, schedule, or shared-state mutations

evidence: Only a new JSON evidence artifact was introduced

repairs_made: Bound the conclusion to repository-grounded evidence only

remaining_uncertainty: External provider state remains inaccessible in this run

checkpoints.claim_or_design_tested: The Cloudflare design is ready for publication or promotion.
challenge_method: Required exact-commit deployment identity, ready state, branch mapping, build/output configuration, route reachability, rollback, and provider-role separation
Rejected branch-search output as a sole source of truth after the observed false negative
evidence: No immutable Cloudflare deployment ID or URL

failures_or_counterexamples_found: The publication claim is falsified by missing provider and deployment identity evidence
repairs_made: Cloudflare remains a reversible candidate path only
remaining_uncertainty: Whether Cloudflare provides value as fallback hosting, edge middleware, DNS only, or no role
Whether duplicate provider deployments would create contradictory public surfaces
checkpoints.rollback_route: No deployment occurred; revert this evidence commit if the record itself must be removed.
checkpoints.next_falsifiable_step: Perform a read-only provider inventory and reject any design that duplicates Vercel ownership without an explicit failover contract.

strongest_surviving_design.canonical_provider: Vercel remains the only repository-policy-backed preview and promotion path.
strongest_surviving_design.cloudflare_role: Unverified optional candidate limited to a clearly bounded role such as DNS, edge controls, or documented fallback; not a second implicit production owner.

rejected_alternatives: Treating branch-search absence as proof that preview does not exist
Treating Cloudflare as active because it was previously discussed
Running an exploratory deployment without verified provider role and branch mapping
Allowing Vercel and Cloudflare to publish the same surface without an explicit authority and failover contract
unresolved_risks: External Cloudflare account/project state is unknown
Preview HEAD and current deployment evidence are not resolved in this record
Provider quota, cancellation, stale-artifact, and branch-mapping behavior remain untested
Duplicate public-surface and DNS authority conflicts remain possible if Cloudflare is later enabled without governance
